title: A simple time budget

D0.outcome: Explains a time budget as an allocation across phases and moves.

D1.outcome: For a fifteen-minute game, writes a budget for the opening, middlegame and endgame.

D2.outcome: Plays three games within the budget and spends more time on critical moments, as the time log shows.

D3.outcome: Revises the budget from the log after a game and states what changed.

misconceptions: The same time on every move is a budget.
conditions: The budget is checked against the time log.
contrasts: An equal budget for every move.
A budget so rigid that critical moments are rushed.
A game with large increments where the budget barely binds.
